description: A kind, motherly woman in her fifties with a warm, slightly low, smooth voice, speaking Italian as her native language with a standard Italian accent. Calm, peaceful and heartfelt, like leading a prayer in a quiet church, with natural human rhythm and phrasing at a normal speaking speed.
ref_text: Gloria al Padre e al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo. Come era nel principio, e ora e sempre, nei secoli dei secoli. Amen.
